overloads.semanticRole: Checks whether aString, taken as a whole, completely matches the regular expression pattern (full-string equality form, no start/position parameters).

params.name: start
params.description: Position in aString where the search starts.
If passed, the search is only carried out at the position specified by start, without continuing further on failure.

overloads.semanticRole: Searches aString for pattern starting at position start, returning the position and length of the (first) match in scalar pos_found/length_found variables.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen over the array-output overload when pos_found/length_found are declared as scalar Integer variables rather than Integer arrays; only the first match is reported.

params.name: start
params.description: Position in aString where the search starts.

params.name: pos_found
params.description: Positions of the whole match (element 0) and each captured group (subsequent elements).

params.name: length_found
params.description: Lengths of the whole match (element 0) and each captured group (subsequent elements).
If passed, the search is only carried out at the position specified by start, without continuing further on failure.

overloads.semanticRole: Searches aString for pattern starting at position start, returning the position and length of the whole match plus each captured group in pos_found/length_found arrays (element 0 = whole match, subsequent elements = capture groups).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen over the scalar-output overload when pos_found/length_found are declared as Integer arrays; the arrays are filled with the whole match at index 0 and each capturing group's position/length at subsequent indices.
